releases.name: Hollow (Ded Hed Studios)
releases.summary: Hollow is a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by old-school dungeon crawlers. Descend beneath a cursed mining town, battle the dead, collect loot, build your character through abilities, and uncover the fallen angel buried below.

releases.name: TRACE//5
releases.summary: This is the ultimate Word Search game for long time word search enthusiasts as well as game newcomers looking for a brief relaxation.  It offers everything that a word search game needs to have, placed in a readable and easy to use interface plus a couple of genius UNIQUE ENHANCEMENTS:     ?  Multiple sizes and difficulties: Set the game in hard or hardest mode to get wonderful combination of your favorite games CROSSWORD and WORD SEARCH.     ?  Choose the “Play with Friends” option to share fun time with you friends and family. Play either in a standard player-versus-player mode or choose the coop mode to solve the puzzle in a joint effort with your friends.LOTS OF PLAYING AIDS:      ?  Two types of word selection: by swiping the letters on the screen, or by tapping the first and the last letter of the word.     ?  Tap on the hint button to quickly find the potential starting letters of a word.      ?  Tap on any word in the word list to see a description of that word and it’s synonyms (very useful when playing on hard or hardest difficulty level).      ?  See the word as you select it letter by letter on the top of the puzzle, away from obstacles like your fingers ?… AND SOMETHING FOR THE GAMERS:     ?  Time based scoring system. Play more difficult and larger puzzles to score more points.     ?  Stars are rewarded if you complete the puzzle quick enough.     ?  Achievement rewards for collecting stars, completing in record times and winning multiplayer duel matches.     ?  Local and global leaderboards. All this combined with great high-resolution graphics and relaxing music completely FREE available for the iPhone, the iPad and the iPod touch.

releases.name: Gatos Adventure
releases.summary: This is a single player stealth like adventure-platformer with puzzle solving element to it. You are trying to escape the Water Cities and in the process collect as many balls of yarn as you can, to buy a place on a vessel that is set to take you to the newly emerging patches of land.

releases.name: Legacy Miner
releases.summary: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

releases.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
releases.summary: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

releases.name: Traffic Architect
releases.summary: The city is the easy part. Making it move isn't. Lay out roads, shape junctions and time the lights, then watch thousands of simulated cars find every flaw you missed. Take cars off the road with buses, trains and metro — or build the whole city yourself in Creative mode.

releases.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
The Wake Event
releases.summary: Awaken aboard a failing research station and uncover its secrets through terminal-driven puzzles, system routing, and environmental exploration.

releases.name: Sister's Training Diary
releases.summary: ○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

releases.name: Hearts Extreme
releases.summary: Hearts Extreme is a single-player card puzzle game that reinvents classic Hearts with unique rules and puzzle mechanics. Master 10 special decks with wild cards, conquer 150+ handcrafted stages across 4, 5, and 6-player modes, and test your bidding skills in daily global leaderboards!

releases.name: Dungebra
releases.summary: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

releases.name: Light Source
releases.summary: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

releases.name: Infi-Knight
releases.summary: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

releases.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
Colorizing: Sunrise
releases.summary:
Coloring by numbers game for relaxation

This coloring book is a guarantee of good mood.
In it you can find all kinds of pictures for every taste.
Coloring by numbers with Colorizing is a calming and easy activity for people of all ages.
This drawing game is suitable for children and adults, everyone can enjoy pixel coloring.
You will definitely love coloring with this beautiful coloring book!

releases.name: Wisp: Elemental Conflict
releases.summary: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

releases.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
releases.summary: Trapped in a tower. A massive horde up ahead! Your gun and turrets are your only companions. Can you defend the tower?
